alerts.title: Glacier Point Road is closed due to the Dome Fire until 10/10 at 7 am
alerts.description: The Dome Fire is burning in the wilderness northeast of Wawona. Glacier Point Road is closed until Saturday, October 10, at 7 am because of reduced visibility along the road due to smoke and to safely allow firefighting operations. Additionally, there are some trail closures south of Glacier Point Road.. Smoky conditions are possible at times.
